chunks: So he was not long in coming, and said: "I have been around where you have not been. I come from Saba with positive news."

key_terms.أَحَطْتُ: I have been around/gained knowledge of

ai.seo_question: What news did the messenger bring from Saba to the Queen?
ai.summary: In this verse, the Queen of Sheba's envoy returns to report his reconnaissance of Solomon’s court, claiming comprehensive knowledge of the environment she had not seen. He brings 'certain news' (naba' yaqin) from Saba, highlighting the transition from hearsay to verified intelligence in the narrative of diplomatic engagement between the two rulers. This moment underscores the theme of divine wisdom being revealed through earthly messengers, a key motif in Shia exegesis regarding the authority of the Prophets.
